question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Concordant
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"concordant"** means **being in agreement or harmony.** (सामंजस्यपूर्ण)

 
 
• **Example: **The views of the committee members were **concordant,** leading to a quick decision.
 
 
 
• **"Harmonious" **refers to forming a pleasing or consistent whole, or being in agreement or concord. (सामंजस्यपूर्ण)
 
 
• **Example: **The **harmonious** relationship between the two countries led to a successful trade agreement.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'concordant' **is **'harmonious'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Certain** (निश्चित): Known for sure; established beyond doubt.

 
 
• **Example:** She is certain that she left her keys on the table.
 
 
 
• **Unanimous** (सर्वसम्मत): Fully in agreement.
 
 
• **Example: **The decision to adopt the new policy was unanimous among the board members.
 
 
 
• **Abnormal** (असामान्य): Deviating from what is normal or usual.
 
 
• **Example:** The doctor noted an abnormal growth on the patient's skin.
